versions.localizedDescription:
Steam64 setup, one step at a time

**Experimental prerelease · Build145 · Known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit. This update improves setup; it does not fix that stability issue.**

What’s new

- **Install Steam64 in the launcher:** downloads the matched Steam/browser packages from Valve over HTTPS, verifies sizes/SHA-256 and installs with rollback. Cancel/retry, Verify/Repair and Return to previous environment are available.
- **Four clear actions:** Install Steam → Connect LocalDevVPN → Pair this device → Enable JIT. Runtime preparation is automatic, signing/address checks remain mandatory, completed steps are checked/skipped and the view follows the next action.
- **Pair in iDeck:** starts the existing on-device pairing immediately with live instructions/PIN, without hunting through JIT settings. iOS calls the pairing host Madeira. Advanced methods/import/recovery/account/auto-start settings are collapsed.
- **Data stays yours:** the original environment remains intact; no auth cache, game or save is silently transferred. Use Valve’s own login and Steam Guard yourself.

Install and test

Download `iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.6-build145.ipa` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the hash, then sign/sideload using your own coherent development main/helper profiles. Keep `MadeiraJITHelper.appex` and debugging permission; signing alone does not activate JIT. Back up saves and keep the same app identity when upgrading—uninstalling can erase local data.

Open iDeck and follow the highlighted setup step; fully close/reopen when prompted after installing Steam64. For on-device pairing use iOS27; iOS26 offers pairing-file import. Activate JIT again for each new app process.

The IPA includes the local runtime and pinned source-built open support components, **no Valve Steam client/libcef, games, accounts, maintainer profile or pairing file**. The installer acquires the client from Valve. Both source companions, relink, license/audit and inventory/checksum assets accompany this release.

What was verified

The user reports Build144 installation can complete. Build145 passed host ordering/skip/restart/signing/VA checks, installer/rollback/privacy regressions, existing JIT integration checks and full Xcode compilation. Its separate Fresh Test version was development-signed, installed/read back and opened on an iPhone15ProMax; original iDeck was preserved. The public ad-hoc IPA was audited (1480files, no findings), and its105-input relink ran with all30TEXT section hashes matching.

The complete revised145 first-run UI, another-device sideload/JIT, new Steam login and repeated gameplay have **not** received a new acceptance result; the public IPA was not installed again after ad-hoc packaging. iPad, Bluetooth and arbitrary games are not validated by this release. Full independent-machine/offline runtime rebuilding is not claimed.

Limits that still matter

- **Third game return may freeze Steam.** Report the first failing stage and game-cycle count.
- Steam64 does **not** enlarge the device’s virtual address space. Unsupported layouts can still fail;32-bit games/helpers may still hit separate limits. Guards remain enabled.
- The compatibility snapshot is **Steam manifest1769025840 (January22,2026), CEF126**, held to its matched components. It is not the latest Steam/Chromium and has security/compatibility limitations; future snapshots need fresh review.
- Game support remains limited. No DRM, authentication or anti-cheat bypass is provided. Never post credentials, Steam Guard data, pairing files, profiles or raw personal logs.

See the four-step guide, Build145 evidence and the bilingual README.

iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.5 · Build 143

**Experimental checkpoint — known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit.**

What changed

- Smoother Steam home/library browsing reported on the test iPhone after reducing periodic diagnostics and pausing hidden log parsing.
- Steam menu now uses the existing window instead of starting a second Steam client and potentially blocking the control helper.
- Improved consistency when reopening the selected Steam64 runtime and its separate saved-login environment.
- VM maintenance and safety guards stay enabled. Experimental GPU-auto and V8 JIT are not promoted to defaults.

What was tested

Build143 was installed on an iPhone15ProMax/A17Pro. The user confirms the Steam menu works and browsing is more fluid. Hot Roads launched and exited three times; **Steam froze after the third return**. This bug remains open. Full build/native37, focused host checks, final-binary markers, package audit and portable relinking passed. Other games, Bluetooth, older devices and prolonged stability are not validated here.

Install / upgrade

Download `iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.5-build143.ipa`, sign it with your own Apple development profiles (including the JIT helper), then complete iDeck's setup/JIT prerequisites. This is an ad-hoc IPA, not pre-signed for your device. Preserve the existing app identity and back up important data before upgrading; avoid uninstalling if you want to retain its data.

English installation guide · 中文 README

**Steam64 setup caveat:** the phone test used an already configured separate Steam64/source-CEF environment. This IPA does not contain Steam/CEF files, games, a preconfigured device prefix or anyone's login. Fresh Steam64 setup is not validated as one-click working; ordinary setup/manual import still applies. iDeck runs the Windows Steam client through Madeira; it does not boot SteamOS.

Source and licenses

The source companion includes the exact application snapshot, pinned component sources, and the matching FEX131 source overlay/options/build recipe. The relink companion contains the exact main-library inputs and a verified relink command. Component licenses/credits and checksums are attached. No FEX upstream contribution is made. No Valve binaries, games, credentials, personal provisioning profiles or pairing files are included.

---

**中文：这是阶段性预发布，第三次退出游戏后 Steam 仍可能卡住。**

本版改善了 Steam 菜单和主页／游戏库浏览，保留内存维护与安全检查。iPhone15ProMax 上已测试三次进入、退出 Hot Roads，但第三次返回后 Steam 卡住，尚未解决长期稳定性。GPU 加速尚未验证为真正硬件后端，未设为默认。

下载 IPA 后需要用自己的 Apple 开发签名重新签署主 App 和 JIT helper，按安装指南完成前置流程。升级请保留原 App 身份并备份重要数据，避免直接卸载。实测的64位 Steam 使用预先配置的独立环境；IPA 不附带 Steam/CEF、游戏、账号或该手机配置，不能把本次实测当作全新设备一键配置成功。

One button closer to your Steam library · Build 99

**Download & Install Steam — directly inside iDeck.** After preparing the local
runtime, download the complete pinned Windows Steam client and CEF/browser files
from Valve's HTTPS CDN. No computer or manual ZIP transfer is needed for acquiring
Steam files. JIT/signing setup may still require a computer on older OS versions.

What's new

- Full 19-package Steam/CEF download with real byte progress, SHA-256 and complete
  6,233-file verification; not just the Dock component bootstrap.
- Cancel, Retry and verified-package caching. Safe streaming ZIP extraction,
  storage/session checks and recoverable public-file installation transactions.
- Repair incomplete or incompatible client files while preserving accounts,
  installed games and saves. Manual import remains available. Fully reopen iDeck
  after installation/repair before enabling JIT.
- iOS/iPadOS26 pipe creation compatibility: fixes a weak-null system API call
  which crashed the runtime before Steam started.
- Browser-thread compatibility: handles the signed ARM64 TEB load captured
  terminating a Steam browser thread after entering Big Picture.
- Removes only the explicitly marked temporary384MB reserve-test configuration
  left by an older experiment, with an original-config backup; custom unmarked
  budgets are preserved.

Install / upgrade

Download **iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.4-build99.ipa** and **SHA256SUMS**. Verify its hash,
then re-sign with your own Apple development profiles, keeping the JIT helper and
`get-task-allow`. The public IPA has certificate-free ad-hoc signatures, contains
no personal provisioning profiles, and requires your signature before sideloading.
Signing alone does not enable JIT. Upgrade in place with consistent identifiers;
back up saves and do not uninstall to repair Steam.

In iDeck: **Prepare runtime → Download & Install Steam → fully reopen iDeck →
JIT setup/Enable JIT → Launch Steam Big Picture**. Complete Steam credentials and
Steam Guard yourself. On iOS26, use a device-specific imported remote pairing file
and manually connect LocalDevVPN. App-internal pairing requires iOS27 or later.

English instructions ·
中文说明 ·
Source verification and limitations

Actual evidence and limits

- All19 official archives remain reachable; full re-download matches historical
  manifest1769731672 and all6233 public file hashes. Native Swift URLSession
  fresh download/install, cancellation/retry and synthetic rollback tests pass.
- A previously Steam-free iPad container completed in-app automatic acquisition
  and full verification. No Steam binaries were manually transferred.
- Build99 compiled, development-signed, installed and launched on iPhone15ProMax;
  the tester confirms Steam UI works after the browser-thread repair. This is
  existing-account evidence, not a fresh-account test or long-session guarantee.
- **Older iPad Pro iPad8,1 cannot boot the current runtime**: measured virtual
  map17.4GB is below its existing48GB32-bit guest-window requirement. Download
  success does not imply every iPad can run Steam. No broad iPad support claimed.
- Production extractor/transaction/manifest, signed-load/neighbor, pipe, startup,
  Steam/JIT/Cloud regressions and six release-tool tests pass. Full Xcode and
  portable104-input relink succeed. IPA payload audit covers1246files.
- The public certificate-free IPA has not separately undergone other-account
  sideloader/JIT testing. No exhaustive game/controller or sustained-session claim.

Important legacy-client limitation

This alpha uses an unmodified pinned **legacy32-bit Windows client1769731672**.
Valve ended32-bit Windows support.
Continued authentication, package availability and security maintenance are not
promised. The inherited frozen-client launch policy remains experimental; the
installer adds no mandatory-update/authentication/DRM bypass. A maintained modern
AMD64 CEF solution remains separate unfinished work. No Valve endorsement or
redistribution …

iDeck v0.1.3-alpha.3 · Build 67

**iDeck brings the Steam Big Picture experience to iOS.** Genuine Windows Steam
runs locally through Madeira/Wine/FEX and Metal. This does not install Linux
SteamOS and is not PC streaming.

What's new since Build 56

- **Repair Steam inside iDeck.** The launcher now identifies missing/incompatible
  client/browser files and provides **Repair Steam files**. Existing account data,
  games and saves are preserved; replaced public program files are backed up.
  Reopen iDeck after repair. A compatible user-supplied client is required when
  no bundled repair source exists: `iDeck/Steam32OfficialRepair` in Files.
- **64-bit game installation detection.** Wine now exposes the existing AMD64
  capability correctly to the legacy Steam client. The user confirmed Ratatan
  could download/install. This does not make every 64-bit game compatible.
- **Ratatan startup/display work.** Preserve emulator allocation headroom and
  Steamworks image space; restore fullscreen preferences with an original-value
  backup; enable the existing WGI controller route for isolated Steam sessions.
  Earlier device evidence reached the game menu. Universal fullscreen, virtual
  controller gameplay and Bluetooth success are not claimed.
- **Re-signed JIT callback repair.** Use URL schemes actually declared by the
  installed app instead of guessing from its Bundle ID. Keep the iDeck shell
  enabled for custom IDs. Correct the bundled shortcut's text output contract.
- **Native Steam CM recovery.** Clean up failed connections, preserve safe numeric
  transport errors and try up to three distinct existing CM endpoints for
  transient failures. Certificate checks stay enabled. This is not a verified
  fix for every LeiShen/Karing TLS issue, nor a Steam Cloud/offline-license bypass.

Upgrade / install

Download **iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.3-build67.ipa**, verify **SHA256SUMS**, and re-sign
with your own Apple development identity and matching main/helper profiles.
Keep the JIT helper and debugging permission. The IPA has certificate-free ad-hoc
signatures; it is not directly installable without your signature.

**If you use Madeira JIT in Shortcuts, re-import it from this version's JIT setup
and replace the old shortcut with the same name.** Updating iDeck does not replace
an already imported workflow. iOS26 users should use the manual LocalDevVPN flow.
Signing does not itself enable JIT.

Back up saves first. Upgrade in place with the same identifiers if preserving
local data; do not uninstall to fix a Steam prerequisite failure. Steam/CEF,
Microsoft redistributables, games, credentials, pairing data and personal signing
profiles are not bundled. Supply a legitimate compatible legacy Windows Steam
client and approve Valve login/Steam Guard yourself.

English setup ·
中文安装流程 ·
Steam recovery ·
Signing guide

Actual checks and limits

- Full iOS Build67, ten focused host regression scripts and six release-tool
  tests passed. Signed shortcut payload/signature/source equality checked.
- 103-input portable relink executed; packaged main/JIT/converter section hashes
  match build products. Nested ad-hoc signatures and 1245-file scoped audit pass.
- **Build67 was development-signed, installed in place and launched on Kusch;
  the user confirmed in-app Steam repair restored use.** The phone's previous
  Steam executable was AMD64 while the compatible repair source was i386.
  The logout-crash causal chain is still unproven.
- The public ad-hoc IPA has no separate other-account sideloader/JIT acceptance
  test. No affected iOS27.2 accelerator TLS, iPad, exhaustive controller/game
  regression or full clean-machine runtime rebuild success is claimed.

This remains a **developer alpha** with limited game compatibility. Companion
assets supply exact application/pinned component sources, LGPL patches/build
recipes, 103 relink inputs, licenses, engineering audit and per-file inventory.
Toolchains/Apple SDK and signing permissions are obtained separat…

iDeck — six checks before takeoff

**iDeck brings the SteamOS experience to iOS.** This developer alpha runs genuine
Windows Steam Big Picture locally through Madeira/Wine/FEX and Metal. It does
not install Linux SteamOS or include Valve's client or games.

New in v0.1.3-alpha.2 · Build 56

- **A step-by-step launcher:** runtime → Steam/CEF → development signing → JIT setup → device connection → JIT for this session.
- **One “Check all prerequisites” button:** checkmarks, missing-condition actions and automatic rechecks after returning to iDeck/JIT setup. Manual launch waits for all six checks.
- **More useful setup checks:** a complete client may use either supported isolated prefix directory; incomplete clients cannot be combined to appear ready. Preparation preserves existing data.
- **English and Chinese README:** IPA signing/sideloading, Steam prerequisites and a staged testing guide.

Downloads and installation

Download **iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.2-build56.ipa** and verify it with **SHA256SUMS**.
The package has certificate-free ad-hoc signatures. **Re-sign it with your own
Apple development identity/profiles**, keeping the JIT helper extension and
debugging permission. Signing does not enable JIT.

English setup ·
中文安装与前置流程 ·
Detailed signing guide

Companion assets include the **exact application source snapshot**, pinned
component/historical sources and vendored Rust dependencies, **103 Build 56
relink inputs**, full component licenses, engineering audit and per-file IPA
inventory. Source/relink instructions are included in those archives.

What was actually checked

- Full iOS Build 56 compilation; launcher-policy, Steam launch/pseudo-process and keyboard host checks; six release-tool unit tests.
- Final linked prerequisite-check strings; portable 103-input relink executed successfully.
- Packaged main/JIT/converter Mach-O sections match build/input copies; all 20 native static libraries match the prior reviewed inputs.
- Nested ad-hoc signatures, 1,245-file scoped IPA audit and complete license/credit inclusion.
- **Earlier Build 55** was installed and launched on Kusch; the checklist was visually observed at **6/6 ready**. A later user foreground switch interrupted the attempted check-button tap, so that tap was not validated.

**Build 56 has no fresh phone-installation, JIT or gameplay validation.** The
Build 55 observation is not a claim of those results for this IPA. No
other-account Sideloadly/AltStore, iPad, Bluetooth or full clean-machine runtime
rebuild success is claimed.

Before testing

Requires iOS 26+, development signing and Madeira's authorized pairing/JIT
workflow. No jailbreak. **Steam setup is still for technical testers:** supply a
legitimate complete compatible legacy Windows Steam/CEF client yourself. The
clean client acquisition/setup flow remains unfinished. Sign in and approve
Steam Guard yourself; account caches are not supplied.

Game support is limited; startup, login transitions and games can hang or fail.
6/6 readiness is not proof a game will work. Back up saves before upgrades and
avoid deleting the app if you need to preserve its local data. Please report
device/OS/build, the first failing stage and redacted diagnostics.

致中文测试者

新版增加六步瀑布式检查与统一检查按钮。先自行签名侧载，再准备 Steam 客户端、配对与
JIT；通过检查后进入真正的 Steam。IPA 不含 Steam、游戏或账号。请分阶段测试启动、
登录、游戏库、游戏和返回流程。兼容游戏有限，本版本仍是技术测试用 Alpha。

Built on the substantial work of Madeira,
Wine, FEX, DXMT, StikJIT and idevice. DroidDeck
inspired the handheld direction. Credits
and component licenses are preserved. Apple's converter retains its separate
included agreement for shader conversion on Apple hardware. The review is an
engineering review, not a lawyer opinion. Independent project, no Valve/Apple
endorsement or authentication/Steam Guard/DRM bypass.

apps.localizedDescription:
ZGTA 5 by zema. Solo Story, Free Roam and private multiplayer. Browser/Mac 1.2; iOS 1.1 beta 1. Your own matching game files required.

Source: https://github.com/zemabinks/ZGTA-V

versions.localizedDescription:
ZGTA 5 1.1 beta 1 — proximity voice

**iOS 109 · Browser 109 · Mac DMG 109.1 · Sileo installer 1.1~beta1**

What's new

- **Proximity voice for private multiplayer:** talk between iPhone and browser players using the existing microphone and speaker buttons.
- **Clearer distance audio:** voices are loud nearby, progressively quieter as players separate, and silent beyond 35 metres. Volume changes are smoothed while moving.
- **Separate voice controls:** switch your microphone off or mute nearby voices while game audio stays separate. No separate multiplayer bridge interface is needed.
- **Same private hosting:** voice uses your compatible Engine LAN relay over LAN or private Tailscale. No public voice service or new account is required.
- **Keep your data:** update over the existing app and retain your game files, saves and settings. Do not delete the app to update.

Updating and limits

The owner confirmed Build 109 installation/data, actual iPhone/Mac speech both ways, smooth distance reduction, out-of-range silence/return and microphone mute. Distances in the owner listening check were estimated; automated native/browser PCM measurements check the actual curve.

The microphone starts off and requires permission. Browser capture needs a secure context, such as the local launcher address or HTTPS. Hiding the game tab pauses voice; enable it again when returning.

Mac 109.1 packages exactly the browser 109 payload tested on Mac. Its launcher sources and pinned runtimes are unchanged from 107.1; mounted hashes, signatures, bundled Intel Python and native-layout checks pass. The109.1 drag-install was not repeated. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.

Windows/Android/Linux and Apple Silicon execution, AppSync installation, Bluetooth/interruption handling and simultaneous speakerphone echo remain unverified. Android is a Termux/browser package, not an APK. This voice release does not claim a new physical 3 GB iPhone performance benchmark.

Stable Sileo installer 1.1~beta1 uses the same tested Build 109 IPA as private 1.1~beta1. Its version, descriptions and public download pins differ; the installation method and app identity are preserved. That public metadata wrapper was not separately phone-tested. AppSync remains experimental for compatible ARM64 rootful devices, not RootHide/rootless.

Your own compatible game files are required. No commercial game content is included. Install/update · Verification scope.

Naming transition

This is the previously owner-tested beta4 payload, renamed **ZGTA 5 — 1.1 beta 1** at the owner’s request. Sileo package version is `1.1~beta1`. App/engine payloads are unchanged; internal Build109/109.1 and old artifact metadata remain valid provenance. The new browser design is a separate private candidate and is not included in this release.

ZGTA V 2.0 beta 3

Downloads · Installation

**iOS 107 · Mac DMG 107.1 · Browser 107 · Mac relay controls 1.1**

What changed

- **More reliable rendering:** fixed buildings flickering or disappearing at
  certain camera angles. The previously affected scene was retested on iPhone.
- **Memory controls for different devices:** Automatic, Standard and Reduced
  memory management are separate from graphics presets, resolution and FPS.
  Reduced mode uses fewer background prefetch jobs and releases completed idle
  graphics storage earlier. Higher-memory devices retain their Standard policy.
- **Heat protection and diagnostics:** frame-rate safeguards preserve saved
  settings, and reports distinguish active session settings from pending changes.
- **LAN server browsing:** discover nearby ZGTA hosts using their announced
  port. Updated managed Mac servers remain visible with zero players, so the
  first player can select the room without entering its address manually.
- **Cleaner settings:** browser Graphics, Controls, Mods, Saves and Support are
  integrated pages under one main navigation. iPhone preset descriptions and
  Find Lobby artwork are corrected.
- **Mac installation:** a new DMG lets you drag ZGTA V into Applications. The
  launcher includes its Python runtime; Chrome and your compatible game files
  are still required.

Updating and current limits

- Keep your existing game files and saves. Install the app update over the
  existing app; do not remove its data to update.
- LAN discovery requires a compatible host announcement and local-network
  access. Existing managed Mac hosts need relay controls1.1 or a ZRemote bundle
  containing the updated helper. This is not a public worldwide server list;
  Tailscale remains a private invite/address connection.
- Reduced-memory improvements have not yet been benchmarked on a physical
  3 GB iPhone SE2020. There is no promise of stable 60 FPS on every device.
- Windows and Android receive the shared browser changes, but execution on
  those devices has not been tested. Android remains a Termux/browser package,
  not an APK.
- The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized. Intel execution was
  checked; the bundled Apple Silicon runtime still needs execution testing.
- This remains a beta. Your own compatible game files are required; no
  commercial game content is included.

ZGTA V candidate 96 — multiplayer host capacity

Applies Glue5's revised bounded host broadcast sizing to **iPhone and browser**: 7500-unit instances 2→3 and 4000-unit instances 4→6. Other host pools, existing player adjustments and larger custom counts are preserved. This excludes the superseded broad increase.

Downloads
- iPhone/iPad: update the existing ZGTA V app with the Build96 IPA or TIPA through compatible TrollStore. The app identity stays the same; keep the app and its data installed.
- Browser: use the complete Mac/Linux, Windows or Android/Termux ZIP. Windows/Android physical testing remains pending.
- Source, verification and SHA-256 sums are included. No game data is supplied.

**iOS 109 · Browser 109 · Mac DMG 109.1 · Sileo installer 1.1~beta1**

What's new

- **Proximity voice for private multiplayer:** talk between iPhone and browser players using the existing microphone and speaker buttons.
- **Clearer distance audio:** voices are loud nearby, progressively quieter as players separate, and silent beyond 35 metres. Volume changes are smoothed while moving.
- **Separate voice controls:** switch your microphone off or mute nearby voices while game audio stays separate. No separate multiplayer bridge interface is needed.
- **Same private hosting:** voice uses your compatible Engine LAN relay over LAN or private Tailscale. No public voice service or new account is required.
- **Keep your data:** update over the existing app and retain your game files, saves and settings. Do not delete the app to update.

Updating and limits

The owner confirmed Build 109 installation/data, actual iPhone/Mac speech both ways, smooth distance reduction, out-of-range silence/return and microphone mute. Distances in the owner listening check were estimated; automated native/browser PCM measurements check the actual curve.

The microphone starts off and requires permission. Browser capture needs a secure context, such as the local launcher address or HTTPS. Hiding the game tab pauses voice; enable it again when returning.

Mac 109.1 packages exactly the browser 109 payload tested on Mac. Its launcher sources and pinned runtimes are unchanged from 107.1; mounted hashes, signatures, bundled Intel Python and native-layout checks pass. The109.1 drag-install was not repeated. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized.

Windows/Android/Linux and Apple Silicon execution, AppSync installation, Bluetooth/interruption handling and simultaneous speakerphone echo remain unverified. Android is a Termux/browser package, not an APK. This voice release does not claim a new physical 3 GB iPhone performance benchmark.

Its version, descriptions and public download pins differ; the installation method and app identity are preserved. That public metadata wrapper was not separately phone-tested. AppSync remains experimental for compatible ARM64 rootful devices, not RootHide/rootless.

Your own compatible game files are required. No commercial game content is included. Install/update · Verification scope.
